strings.en: The same opponent, the same Pokémon,{NEWLINE}and yet the result can be the{CLEAR}complete opposite!{SCROLL}I’d like to battle with you again.{NEWLINE}Let’s trade phone numbers!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 等我准备完毕后{NEWLINE}会打电话和你联系的！
strings.en: Once I’ve gotten ready, I’ll give you{NEWLINE}a call!
I see... Well, that’s fine by me.{NEWLINE}I’ve always got my mountain!

strings.zh: 我还想和你再对战一次,{NEWLINE}所以请你一定要和我{CLEAR}交换一下电话号码啊！{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哎？感觉我好像能{NEWLINE}清楚地听到你的声音啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}原来你就在附近啊？{NEWLINE}那直接和我面谈好了！
strings.en: That’s strange...{NEWLINE}I can hear your voice so clearly...{SCROLL}Wait, you’re nearby, aren’t you!{NEWLINE}Let’s talk in person!

strings.zh: 热爱大自然的登山男{NEWLINE}更能驯服精灵！{SCROLL}这不是我自己想的！{NEWLINE}你看,{CLEAR}我的{VAR:0100:10}{CLEAR}就非常听我的话！
strings.en: Pokémon easily develop an affection for{NEWLINE}us nature-loving Hikers!{SCROLL}No, no, it’s not just my imagination!{NEWLINE}I’ve got proof! Seriously, my{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:10} never disobeys me!

strings.zh: 你听我说！{SCROLL}昨天我遇到了野生的{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}！{CLEAR}就在这片大自然中！{SCROLL}当然,我的精灵们{NEWLINE}也上演了一场精彩的战斗！{CLEAR}嗯,就在这片大自然中！{SCROLL}我该如何描述这种感受呢⋯⋯{CLEAR}不管了,{SCROLL}拜拜！
strings.en: Hey, listen up!{SCROLL}Yesterday, I ran into a wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}! Right out here in nature!{SCROLL}Of course, my Pokémon put on a great{NEWLINE}battle! Yep, right out here in nature!{SCROLL}How can I describe this{NEWLINE}feeling... Oh, never mind.{SCROLL}Bye!

strings.zh: 前几天在爬山的时候,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}突然{CLEAR}跳了出来。{SCROLL}我当时没有心理准备,{NEWLINE}所以被它给逃掉了。{SCROLL}登山男应该是{NEWLINE}随时都准备着的,{CLEAR}我实在是太丢{CLEAR}我们登山男的脸了！
strings.en: A few days ago, while I was hiking in the{NEWLINE}mountains, a wild {VAR:0100:11}{CLEAR}suddenly jumped out at me.{SCROLL}I was completely unprepared for the{NEWLINE}experience, and it ran away.{SCROLL}It’s said we Hikers stake our life on{NEWLINE}being prepared for anything, so I have{CLEAR}to count this as a failure as a Hiker!

strings.zh: 我想现在{NEWLINE}你也差不多想{CLEAR}和我来一场{CLEAR}对战了吧？{SCROLL}怎么样？{NEWLINE}再来和我对战一场吧,{CLEAR}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: I figure you must be about ready{NEWLINE}for another battle with me, right?{SCROLL}How about it? Come battle me again.{NEWLINE}I’ll be waiting at {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 我和你的对战{NEWLINE}将在{VAR:0104:3}进行,{CLEAR}我在大自然中等着你！
strings.en: We’re having a battle on{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}, remember. I’m out{CLEAR}here, waiting in the midst of nature!

strings.zh: 对了,我的一年{NEWLINE}几乎都在山中度过。{SCROLL}洗澡？{SCROLL}山里哪有这种条件！{SCROLL}不过,看到一些清澈的河流时,{NEWLINE}我也会过去冲凉,{CLEAR}不至于弄得自己太脏。{SCROLL}对了,前段时间{NEWLINE}在和里冲完凉之后,{CLEAR}别人还以为我是大海男子！
strings.en: That’s right... I’m up on this mountain{NEWLINE}almost the whole year round...{SCROLL}Baths?{SCROLL}There’s no such thing on a mountain!{SCROLL}Instead, I just look for a flowing{NEWLINE}river, and wash myself off in that.{SCROLL}That’s right! A few days ago, when{NEWLINE}I was bathing in the river, someone{CLEAR}mistook me for a Swimmer♂!
